name: English
lead: Take a brand-new character all the way to a full Tier 8 set, wearing only what you crafted yourself from resources you obtained.
note: This challenge is just for fun. Nobody checks anyone: anyone can join, and honesty is a personal challenge to yourself.

ul: Create a new character. Starting with an already leveled character is not allowed.
Share your progress in the {twitch} chat.

p: Wear only what you crafted yourself from resources you obtained.

ul: Wearing your own craft: weapon, off-hand, head, armor, shoes, bag and cape
Crafting from what you obtained yourself: gathering and any loot — mobs, chests, killed players, rewards, salvaging items you found
Wearing anything bought, gifted, found or dropped
Crafting equipment from bought or gifted resources

p: You may buy tools, gathering gear and mounts until you can make them yourself.
ul: Tools and gathering gear — separately for each item and tier: once you unlock its crafting, only your own from then on.
Example: you unlocked crafting the T4 pickaxe — the T4 pickaxe must be your own, but you may still buy a T5 pickaxe.
Mounts: any, until you can raise that mount yourself. Once you can — only your own.
